🔴 COPY THIS FIRST — Minute 0 of Your Exam!

⚡ The Block — Paste into Your Terminal Immediately

BASH — Run this FIRST when your exam starts. Saves 10+ minutes.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# CKAD EXAM SPEED SYSTEM — Copy ENTIRE block
# Paste into your exam terminal at Minute 0
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

# ─── CORE ALIASES (save 2-3 keystrokes per command) ───
alias k=kubectl
alias kg='kubectl get'
alias kd='kubectl describe'
alias krm='kubectl delete'
alias ka='kubectl apply -f'
alias kc='kubectl create'
alias kr='kubectl run'
alias ke='kubectl explain'
alias kx='kubectl exec'
alias kl='kubectl logs'

# ─── DRY-RUN SHORTCUT (scaffold YAML in 1 command) ───
# Usage: kr pod nginx --image=nginx $do > pod.yaml
export do="--dry-run=client -o yaml"

# ─── FORCE DELETE (when pods won't terminate) ───
export now="--force --grace-period=0"

# ─── NAMESPACE SWITCHER (faster than -n every time) ───
alias kn='kubectl config set-context --current --namespace'

# ─── USEFUL SHORTCUTS ───
alias kall='kubectl get all'
alias kaf='kubectl apply -f'
alias kdf='kubectl delete -f'
alias kga='kubectl get all -A'
alias kgaa='kubectl get all --all-namespaces'

# ─── VERIFY ───
echo "✅ CKAD Speed System loaded!"
echo "  k  = kubectl"
echo "  kg = kubectl get"
echo "  kd = kubectl describe"
echo "  ka = kubectl apply -f"
echo "  kc = kubectl create"
echo "  kr = kubectl run"
echo "  kl = kubectl logs"
echo "  kx = kubectl exec"
echo "  do = --dry-run=client -o yaml"
echo "  now = --force --grace-period=0"
echo "  kn = switch namespace"
echo ""
echo "Usage: kg po -o wide   (instead of kubectl get pods -o wide)"
echo "       kr nginx --image=nginx -o yaml $do > pod.yaml"

⚡ The 20 Commands You MUST Type Without Thinking

1k run NAME --image=IMG $do > file.yaml
Scaffold pod YAML. #1 time-saver in the exam. NEVER write YAML from scratch.
2k create deploy NAME --image=IMG $do > deploy.yaml
Scaffold Deployment YAML. Add replicas, probes, resources AFTER.
3k expose deploy NAME --port=P --target-port=TP $do
Create Service YAML. Add --type=NodePort for external access.
4k set image deploy/NAME *=IMG:TAG
Update image + trigger rollout. *=NAME means ALL containers.
5k create cm NAME --from-literal=K=V $do > cm.yaml
ConfigMap YAML from literal values. Add more --from-literal as needed.
6k create secret generic NAME --from-literal=K=V $do
Secret YAML. NEVER write Secrets in YAML manually — let kubectl encode.
7k create secret tls NAME --cert=CERT --key=KEY
TLS Secret. Sets correct type (kubernetes.io/tls) + keys (tls.crt, tls.key).
8k create sa NAME $do > sa.yaml
ServiceAccount YAML — then k create role + k create rolebinding.
9k create role NAME --verb=get,list --resource=pods $do
Role YAML. Remember: get ≠ list — both must be specified!
10k create rolebinding NAME --role=R --sa=NS:SA $do
RoleBinding YAML. ServiceAccount format: namespace:name.
11k auth can-i VERB RES --as=system:sa:NS:SA
Test RBAC permissions. Use BEFORE deploying to verify access.
12k rollout undo deploy/NAME --to-revision=N
Rollback to specific revision. k rollout history deploy/NAME first.
13k scale deploy/NAME --replicas=N
Scale up/down instantly. No YAML editing needed.
14k exec POD -- COMMAND
Execute command in pod. -- for multi-container: -c CONTAINER.
15k logs POD --previous
Logs from PREVIOUS crashed container. #1 CrashLoopBackOff debug tool.
16k get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp
Sorted events. See what JUST happened in the cluster.
17k explain RESOURCE.FIELD --recursive
Built-in docs. No browser needed. Find any field path instantly.
18k patch RES NAME --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace"...}]'
JSON patch. Faster than edit for single-field changes. Find field path first.
19k run test --image=busybox --rm -it --restart=Never -- sh
Instant debug pod. Test DNS, wget Services, nslookup. Cleans up after exit.
20k delete ns NAME
🔴 NUCLEAR OPTION. Deletes EVERYTHING in namespace. Use to reset between questions.

🧠 Exam Strategy — Time Management

Min 0: Paste the alias block. Set namespace. Bookmark k8s.io/docs.
Min 0-5: Skim ALL 19 questions. Flag easy ones. Do them FIRST.
Per question: Read → Scaffold YAML ($do) → Edit YAML → Apply → Verify → NEXT. Don't debug for 10 minutes — move on, come back.
Min 100: Leave 20 minutes for review. Revisit flagged questions.
Weight: Questions are WEIGHTED. A 12% question is worth more than a 4% question. Check the weight percentage displayed in the exam UI!

⚠️ Common CKAD Time Wasters

❌ Writing YAML from scratch — use $do ALWAYS
❌ Typing kubectl 100 times — alias k=kubectl
❌ Switching contexts manually — Exam provides context commands
❌ Debugging one question for 15 min — FLAG IT, MOVE ON
❌ Not using k explain — built-in docs, no alt-tab
❌ Copy-pasting from PDF docs — type imperatively instead
❌ Forgetting to set namespace — use kn NAMESPACE
❌ Not verifying after apply — kg po -w, k rollout status

⚠️ Common Roadmap Pitfalls

❌ Skipping Docker. CKAD expects Docker knowledge. Don't jump straight to Kubernetes.
❌ Reading-only. Each week requires hands-on practice with the 6-cluster lab.
❌ No speed practice. CKAD is a speed exam. Use Appendix I aliases from Week 1.
❌ Skipping Decision Trees. Trees teach diagnostic reasoning — critical for Troubleshooting questions.
❌ Wrong order. Don't do Advanced MCQs before Novice. Build foundation first.
❌ No timed practice. You MUST complete S1-S100 under time pressure at least twice.

Default: deny-all ingress
django→postgres: port 5432 only
django→redis: port 6379 only
Ingress→django: port 8000 only
👤 RBAC
ns: easypj (isolated)
SA: django-sa (least privilege)
Role: pod-reader, secret-reader
ClusterRole: none (no cluster-wide access)
2 Pod Security — SecurityContext + Pod Security Standards
🔐 SecurityContext
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000
fsGroup: 2000
allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
🏷️ Pod Security Admission
Enforce: restricted
No hostPath, no hostNetwork
No privileged containers
SeccompProfile: RuntimeDefault
🔑 Secrets Management
REST encryption at rest
No secrets in env (use volumes)
SealedSecrets for GitOps
Rotation policy: 90 days
3 Admission Control — kyverno Policies (Beyond CKAD → CKS)
📋 kyverno: require-labels
Mutates: adds app.kubernetes.io/* labels
Validates: Deployment must have "app" label
Validates: Namespace must have "owner" label
📋 kyverno: require-probes
Validates: every Deployment must have
livenessProbe + readinessProbe
Rejects if probes are missing
📋 kyverno: disallow-latest-tag
Validates: image tag != "latest"
Requires explicit version tags
Blocks: easypj/jobpost:latest

📊 Difficulty Legend & Strategy

🟢 Novice — Core concepts. Must get 90%+ correct. Foundation for everything else.
🟡 Intermediate — Applied skills. Target 80%+ correct. These are the CKAD bread-and-butter.
🔴 Advanced — Production expertise. Target 70%+ correct. Differentiates top scorers.
🚀 Beyond — Post-CKAD growth. Explore at your pace. Not on the CKAD exam.
📋 Exam Strategy: The CKAD exam weights questions differently. A 12% question is worth 3× a 4% question. If you're stuck on a 🔴 Advanced scenario, flag it, move on, and return later. Secure all 🟢 and 🟡 points first.
